title: Keep terminal font size on this machine, not in the shared config
head: 5c0251ecd7d9
workflow: Opus full review, Sol boundary hunter, Opus self-check of the draft, editorial check, batch gates

leads.summary: Kitty's absolute globinclude never imports the generated size
leads.consequence: After `omarchy font size 11`, the appended `globinclude ~/.config/kitty/local.conf` expands to an absolute pattern. Kitty v0.48.2 calls `Path(base_path_for_includes).glob(val)`, which rejects absolute patterns with `NotImplementedError`. Kitty catches this as a bad configuration line and opens an error display, but ignores local.conf; effective font size remains the inherited 9pt. Use `include ~/.config/kitty/local.conf` or a relative `globinclude local.conf`.
leads.triage: corroborated; = Opus F2 (Kitty absolute globinclude); visible

leads.summary: Appending Foot's include at EOF places it under the last section
leads.consequence: For an existing customized foot.ini with `[scrollback]`, `[text-bindings]`, etc. and no include, the command appends `include=...` below the last section, not in `[main]`. Foot dispatches it to that section's parser, not `parse_section_main`; the overlay never changes the font and may produce a config error. Insert the include under `[main]` or make a section-aware edit.
leads.triage: corroborated; = Opus F1 (Foot include in last section); visible

leads.summary: Nondefault XDG_CONFIG_HOME writes overlays to a directory the include paths do not read
leads.consequence: With XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/xdg, all four overlays go under $HOME/xdg while shipped Ghostty/Foot/Alacritty includes and newly appended Kitty include still target $HOME/.config. No terminal loads the changed sizes. Use XDG-aware paths for all four includes; account for existing shipped lines when deciding whether a rewrite is needed.
leads.triage: corroborated; = Opus F11 (XDG); collapsed, reproducer added after editorial check

leads.summary: Migration detaches symlink-managed configs for three terminals
leads.consequence: GNU sed -i replaces the symlink with a regular file for Ghostty, Foot and Alacritty; Kitty explicitly uses --follow-symlinks. The original dotfile target keeps the old size, and later synced changes cease to affect the local terminal. Preserve symlink targets or skip and explain the manual migration for managed files.

leads.summary: Setting size silently changes a custom Foot family
leads.consequence: The local Foot file contains a full `font=` declaration; `write_size` picks its family from global `fc-match monospace` via `omarchy-font-current`, not from Foot's shared `font=` line. If a user put `font=Iosevka` in foot.ini without changing fontconfig, `omarchy font size 11` creates `font=JetBrainsMono Nerd Font:size=11`; the include overrides the user's family. Read and preserve the Foot family/options actually configured, and alter just the size.

leads.summary: Seeding per-machine overlays from /etc/skel makes a destructive resync reset them to 9pt
leads.consequence: omarchy-settings copies every config/** file to /etc/skel/.config/**, so these four files are treated as package defaults, not per-machine-generated state. `omarchy reinstall configs` copies `/etc/skel/.` over the user's home and resets every overlay (including a custom 14pt one) to 9pt; later `omarchy-font-size` reports 9pt. Split the per-machine overlays from config/** or explicitly preserve them on reinstall/resync. This is distinct from normal pacman upgrades, which do not recopy /etc/skel into existing HOME.
leads.triage: dropped; omarchy reinstall configs resetting overlays to 9 is consistent with an explicit reset command (Opus assessed the same); not a defect

leads.summary: A custom Alacritty config without general.import never loads its new overlay
leads.consequence: The code only attempts to insert an import when a literal `general.import` already exists, and the regex does not recognize the valid TOML `[general]` + `import = [...]` form. A user-authored alacritty.toml containing `[font]` but no imports gets local.toml written yet remains at its previous/default size. Create/extend an import in valid TOML for all supported config shapes rather than silently succeeding.
leads.triage: confirmed_published; factual: coordinator verified bin/omarchy-font-size:81 conditional and migration size deletion from pinned source; Opus then reproduced it (reproducers/alacritty-no-general-import.md); shipped configs all use general.import, so only hand-written configs

leads.summary: Another open PR's safe Hyprland override loader still aborts on this added local file
leads.consequence: A malformed existing `input.local.lua` raises in unguarded dofile and prevents later toggle/config statements. Open #9976 explicitly makes personal modules safe and loads bindings first so malformed input cannot terminate Hyprland initialization; a clean three-way merge preserves this PR's dofile after its safe() calls, reintroducing the fatal path for that new optional input. Wrap local loading with its safe loader or pcall after checking actual file errors; add a broken-local-input fixture.
leads.triage: dropped; interaction with unmerged #9976 loader; hypothetical, depends on another PR

leads.summary: The supplied Kitty and Foot tests miss failures in their actual config parsers
leads.consequence: The new assertions only search for include substrings, so they pass when Kitty rejects the absolute glob and Foot handles an include inserted under a later section instead of [main]. The existing native Kitty fixture tests only the stock theme include, not an `omarchy-font-size`-generated overlay; it is skipped entirely if Kitty is absent. Add parser-level fixtures using generated config files and user-edited Foot with trailing sections.
leads.triage: corroborated; test-gap notes for Foot and Kitty in Optional notes

leads.summary: Migration collapses different pre-existing terminal sizes into one value
leads.consequence: When both Ghostty and Kitty are installed and their shared configs specify 9pt and 15pt respectively, this script takes the first Ghostty value, writes 9pt to all four overlays, then removes Kitty's 15pt line. On the next run the local Ghostty 9pt wins again; Kitty's previous preference is not recoverable from its config. If preserving each terminal's existing size is required, extract and migrate sizes per terminal instead of using one global size, with a defined policy for the current-size display.
leads.triage: corroborated; = Opus F3 (one size for all); visible

leads.summary: Open #8880's selected-terminal size reporter conflicts with the new overlay reader
leads.consequence: Open nonstacked #8880 changes term_current_pt to report the currently selected terminal rather than the first installed one. Three-way merging its head and this PR produces conflict markers in that function. Keeping #8880's old shared-file reader after this PR's migration reports empty/default instead of the overlay size, while keeping this PR's new reader discards #8880's selected-terminal behaviour. Resolve with a selected-terminal-aware overlay reader if both features merge.
leads.triage: corroborated; #8880 overlap, verified read-only, listed in related PRs

leads.summary: Zero is accepted as a font size but Kitty clamps it to 4pt while the command reports 0
leads.consequence: `omarchy font size 0` exits successfully and writes size 0 to all four overlays, then `omarchy font size` reports 0. Kitty's shipped parser enforces a minimum of 4pt (after H01's include is fixed), so the reported setting and rendered size differ. Validate a positive, interoperable range before writing any overlays (including in migration's parsed input).
leads.triage: partially_corroborated; = Opus F9 (0 accepted); Kitty clamping to 4pt not verified, not published

leads.summary: Potential conflict with open XDG font PR requires manual reconciliation
leads.consequence: Open #8179 changes both shared font commands to use $XDG_CONFIG_HOME while this PR replaces display's setter/reader and modifies Foot's family rewrite. Both heads are diverged; `git merge-file` produces conflicts in both files, consistent with GitHub CONFLICTING. Resolving by retaining #8179's old setter would rewrite shared terminal files instead of the overlays; resolve to the new helper and carry #8179's XDG updates into font-set, shell and fontconfig instead.
leads.triage: corroborated; #8179 conflict, verified read-only (dirty), listed in related PRs

# RETRO: omacom/omarchy#11487 (team 2)

## What worked
- The hunter corroborated 10 of Opus's findings independently and added one confirmed lead (H07, Alacritty configs without general.import).
- The Opus self-check caught two wrong claims (a test-gap statement and a probe labelled as a failing reproducer) and seven overstatements, including a dropped part of the Kitty fix (duplicate check) and an #8825 misattribution, all carried over from the final report.
- Asking Opus to edit its own reproducer files kept the "paste unchanged" rule intact while fixing editorial privacy issues.

## Friction
- `review_team.py visible_length` uses a non-greedy `<details\b.*?</details>` regex, so nested `<details>` blocks are miscounted: everything after the first inner `</details>` counts as visible. The draft was restructured to use flat blocks. Tool fix suggestion: make it nesting-aware, or warn on nested details.
- Reproducers contained internal run names, harness scenario paths and a severity label. Reviewer prompt or reproducer template could say: no plan/run identifiers, synthetic short HOME paths (for example /tmp/h), no severity labels.
- Sol took about 50 minutes, longer than the typical 15 to 25. It stayed active throughout, so it was not interrupted.

## Process deviations (from the Opus report)
- Opus ran `bash -n` on its own fixture scripts on the host (parse only, not PR code); policy routes `bash -n` through review.py.
- One Opus clone command with a misplaced `&` briefly ran from the intake working directory; Opus reports it created nothing there.
- One unsealed full-suite run was stopped after it hung in omarchy-kernel-migration-test.sh, and is excluded from the evidence.
None affects the public claims, which rest on sealed runs.

## Carry forward
- For multi-finding reviews, budget the visible text from the start: three visible findings plus the fixed header and footer leave about 1,000 characters.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The migration breaks Foot on existing installs, and Kitty never loads its overlay.

### Foot include lands in `[text-bindings]`

On existing installs `include=` is appended under `[text-bindings]`; Foot reads it only in `[main]`. **Impact:** after migrating, `foot -C` exits 230 and Foot, the default terminal, drops to 8 pt.

**Suggested change:** Write `[main]` before a `~/.config/foot/local.ini` include.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 5c0251e)</summary>

Kitty expands `~` and pathlib glob rejects the absolute pattern. **Impact:** Kitty shows a config error and ignores `omarchy font size`.

**Suggested change:** Use `globinclude local.conf`, also in the duplicate check.

### Migration gives every terminal one size

It copies the first size found (Ghostty first) to every overlay. **Impact:** the stock Ghostty 9 overrides Alacritty's `size = 12`.

**Suggested change:** Migrate each terminal's own size.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 5c0251e)</summary>

# Reproducer: Migration replaces a terminal's own size with Ghostty's

Every install is seeded with all four terminal configs, so the stock Ghostty value (9) is read first even when the user only uses, and only customized, another terminal.

Save as `test/shell.d/font-size-migration-per-terminal-test.sh` in a checkout of the PR head (5c0251ecd7d94de9ca05423d321e4ad29b51017f) and run `bash test/shell.d/font-size-migration-per-terminal-test.sh`. It uses the repository's `base-test.sh` helpers and a temporary HOME; nothing outside the temporary directory is touched.

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/base-test.sh"

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
home="$tmpdir/home"
mkdir -p "$home/.config/ghostty" "$home/.config/alacritty" "$tmpdir/bin"
printf '#!/bin/bash\nexit 1\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/pgrep"
printf '#!/bin/bash\necho "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"\n' >"$tmpdir/bin/omarchy-font-current"
chmod +x "$tmpdir/bin/"*

# Every install is seeded with all four terminal configs. This user only uses
# Alacritty and set its size to 12; the unused Ghostty config still has the stock 9.
printf 'font-family = "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"\nfont-size = 9\n' >"$home/.config/ghostty/config"
cat >"$home/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml" <<'TOML'
general.import = [ "~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/alacritty.toml" ]

[font]
normal = { family = "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font", style = "Regular" }
size = 12
TOML

HOME="$home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$home/.config" PATH="$tmpdir/bin:$ROOT/bin:$PATH" \
```
